name: Recourse
why_studionet: On testnet-asimov emit_transfer records a payout and leaves balances untouched, measured across two deployments. A contract whose point is that money moves cannot demonstrate it there.

superseded.reason: gl.evm.contract_interface was used as a base class rather than a decorator, so the module never imported and the deployment produced no contract while reporting success
no deadlines and no recovery paths: a party who stopped participating could freeze the fee forever, and a delivery was party-authored text pinned to nothing

verified: Three settlement paths on chain. A contested delivery ruled REFUND and the client's balance went 667.9 to 668.0 GEN. A job the worker never delivered was RECLAIMED after its deadline, client 667.8 to 667.9. A delivery the client never answered was claimed as UNCONTESTED after the review window, worker 137.4467 to 137.5467. Wrong-party attempts at each guard were refused without moving the fee.
